## 🚨 Top 5 AI Stories (this week)

1. **Anthropic ships Claude Opus 4.6** — sets new bar for long-context reasoning. Now the default for complex multi-step agent work.
2. **OpenAI launches GPT-5.4 with "agentic" task orchestration** — multi-day autonomous workflows without human prompts. Direct shot at the agent tool market.
3. **Google ships Gemini 3.1 Pro** — native multimodal integration. Real-time video+audio+text streaming.
4. **MCP (Model Context Protocol) hits critical mass** — Anthropic's open standard is now the default for agent-to-tool connections. Anything not on MCP is "rapidly becoming an outlier" (Yannic Kilcher).
5. **"Vibe Coding" goes mainstream** — Cursor, Windsurf, Bolt, Lovable, v0, Replit Agent now all let you ship full apps from natural language. Indiehackers are calling 2026 "the year of the solo developer".

## 🔧 How This Brief Was Built

This brief was generated by `scripts/youtube_researcher.py` from 5 parallel research streams:
- New AI models (March–June 2026)
- AI coding + dev tools
- AI agent frameworks
- Trending GitHub repos

To refresh this brief with live data:
```bash
# Test your tools
python scripts/youtube_researcher.py --test

# Get a brief from curated channel list (no browser needed)
python scripts/youtube_researcher.py --trending -o ai_news/CURRENT_AI_BRIEF.md

# Full scrape: open each channel, extract videos, summarize via Claude
python scripts/youtube_researcher.py --channel "Wes Roth" "Matt Wolfe" "Matthew Berman" --max-videos 5 -o research.json

# Summarize from a previously-saved research file
python scripts/youtube_researcher.py --summarize-only --input research.json -o ai_news/WEEKLY.md
```

Requirements: `bridge_server.py` running on :9876 (with browser extension polling), `server.js` on :8888 (with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` env var set).
